overview.title: What we offer, for individuals and for business.
overview.text: Helix Insurance Group has the ability to shop among the most financially stable and reliable insurance companies to find the right insurance policy that meets your needs, coverage, and budget today.

services.title: Auto
services.text: Feel confident when driving is what we provide. So steer your way to confidence and savings.
services.lead: Auto insurance is something we all must have in the State of Texas, by law, so make sure you are covered adequately when you need it. Buying more than the state's minimum requirement will protect your assets if you get into an accident.
services.imageAlt: A car on an open road

covers.title: Bodily Injury Liability
covers.text: Covers the designated driver or policyholder if they injure others. Family members listed on your policy are also covered if driving another person's vehicle with their permission. Be careful with the minimum liability coverage, because the amount you buy may not cover you completely in a serious accident or if you are served with a lawsuit.

covers.title: Medical Payments
covers.text: Pays for the care of injuries to the driver and passengers of the policyholder's car in the event of an accident, and depending on the amount of coverage you choose can cover medical costs, lost wages and possible funeral costs.

covers.title: Property Damage Liability
covers.text: Covers the damage you, or someone driving your car with your permission, does to another person's property, such as lamp posts, telephone poles, buildings and fences.

covers.title: Collision
covers.text: Covers damage to your car that results from a collision with another vehicle or object, including potholes or if it flips over. A higher deductible will result in a lower premium.

covers.title: Comprehensive
covers.text: Covers your car when it is stolen or damaged by something other than a collision, such as fire, falling objects, explosions, hail or vandalism, and reimburses you if your windshield is cracked or shattered. Some companies offer glass coverage with or without a deductible.

covers.title: Uninsured and Underinsured Motorist
covers.text: Reimburses you, a family member or a designated driver when you are hit by an uninsured driver or a hit and run, or when an at-fault driver does not carry enough insurance. It can also apply if you are hit as a pedestrian.

services.title: Home
services.text: Owning a home is one of the biggest investments you will ever make, let us help you protect it.
services.lead: Unlike auto insurance, homeowners insurance has many components involved that determine the quality of coverage. In most cases our houses will be the largest investment we will ever make, which is why it is important to make sure your investment is properly covered.
services.imageAlt: A family home with a covered porch

covers.title: Coverage A – Dwelling
covers.text: Applies to the primary structure of the home and may include structures attached to it, such as an attached garage, carport or deck. It is critically important that your policy is 100 percent replacement.

covers.title: Coverage B – Other Structures
covers.text: Anything detached or separated from the home that is damaged, such as a detached garage, shed, pool or outdoor storage.

covers.title: Coverage C – Personal Property
covers.text: Property owned by the insured or a family member residing at the residence. If you flipped your house upside down, everything that would fall out counts: appliances, clothing, furniture.

covers.title: Coverage D – Loss of Use
covers.text: Pays out for additional living expenses incurred because you are unable to reside in your home.

covers.title: Coverage E – Personal Liability
covers.text: Covers claims or suits brought against an insured because of bodily injury or damages while on your property.

covers.title: Endorsements and additional coverages
covers.text: Scheduled jewelry, firearms and fine arts; pipe burst; extension to a secondary residence; water back-up of sewer or drains; mold limited fungi coverage; watercraft and jet ski options.

questions.q: Should somebody look over the policy I have now?
questions.a: It is a good practice to have a reliable agent review your policy to ensure your coverage is suitable to your possible risks.

services.title: Life
services.text: The most important part of buying life insurance is determining how much you need and we can help.
services.lead: Life insurance is a crucial step in planning for your future and the future of your loved ones. It can fulfill promises made to your family if you are no longer around by providing a death benefit to your beneficiaries, and it can also provide benefits while you are living.

covers.title: Term life insurance
covers.text: Protection for a specified period of time, generally less expensive than permanent life insurance, available in varying terms with fixed premiums from one year to a 20-year level term. It can sometimes be converted to permanent coverage.

covers.title: Universal life insurance
covers.text: Permanent coverage characterized by flexible premiums, flexible face amounts and unbundled pricing. It can build cash value, which earns an interest rate that may adjust but is usually guaranteed not to fall below a certain percentage.

covers.title: Whole life insurance
covers.text: Permanent coverage that remains in force during the insured person's lifetime, provided the premiums are paid as specified in the policy, and that can build cash value.

covers.title: Living benefits
covers.text: Loans or withdrawals can be taken against the cash value of a permanent policy to help with expenses, such as college tuition or the down payment on a home.

covers.title: Death benefits
covers.text: Income tax-free money to your named beneficiaries for funeral expenses, debt, tuition or estate taxes, and business security that enables partners to buy out a deceased partner's interest and prevent a forced liquidation.

covers.title: Policy reviews
covers.text: A look at your coverage once a year, because when changes in your life happen you want to make sure you and your loved ones are well prepared.

questions.q: How do I determine how much life insurance I need?
questions.a: The value should be on average 8 to 10 times your income. We can assist you in determining an appropriate coverage amount and help you decide which type of life insurance is right for you.

questions.q: What should I weigh when assessing my needs?
questions.a: A spouse, dependent children, aging parents or a physically challenged relative who depends on you, retirement savings that are not sufficient for your spouse's future, a sizable estate, and a business.

services.title: Recreational
services.text: Selecting your motorcycle is a big decision. Protecting your motorcycle is easy.
services.lead: Whether you are a weekend warrior, a casual rider or a hardcore motorcyclist, our motorcycle insurance policy offers protection for you, your bike and your accessories. The policy is designed to meet the personal and financial needs of most motorcycle owners.
services.imageAlt: A motorcycle parked on a coastal road

covers.title: Coverage and deductibles you pick
covers.text: All you need to do is choose the type of coverage and deductibles that best cover your motorcycle and your lifestyle, and we will do the rest.

covers.title: Competitive prices and payment plans
covers.text: We offer competitive prices plus convenient payment plans.

covers.title: A carrier that will be there
covers.text: We place your coverage with a company that has the financial stability to be there when you need them most.

covers.title: Discounts
covers.text: No doubt you will qualify for some of our discounts that will make your motorcycle insurance premiums even lower.

covers.title: Boats, umbrella and more
covers.text: Our agents also write boats, recreational life and umbrella coverage alongside your other policies.

services.title: Business Owners
services.summary: A BOP bundle for small businesses.
services.text: When you have to have it, we can deliver. Call us to protect your business and future.
services.lead: A business owners policy, or BOP insurance, provides a bundle of basic coverages for small businesses. We offer a competitive product portfolio with coverages that include the following.
services.imageAlt: The counter of a small business

covers.title: Building and structures
covers.text: The building your business works out of and the structures that go with it.

covers.title: Newly acquired or constructed buildings
covers.text: Buildings added to the business after the policy is written.

covers.title: Business income and extra expense
covers.text: Income lost and the extra costs carried while the business recovers.

covers.title: Glass breakage
covers.text: Storefront and interior glass.

covers.title: Backup of sewers and drains
covers.text: Damage from water backing up through sewers and drains.

covers.title: Outdoor property and more
covers.text: Outdoor property on the premises, and further coverages in the portfolio.

services.title: Commercial Auto
services.summary: Work vehicles, hired and non-owned autos.
services.text: Auto insurance is something we all must have in the State of Texas, by law, so make sure you are covered adequately when you need it.
services.lead: We understand how difficult it could be for a business if one of the commercial vehicles is out of service for repair or replacement. Our commercial auto coverage aims to provide prompt, responsive and fair service to help minimize business disruption by getting vehicles back on the road as quickly as possible.
services.imageAlt: A work van parked at a job site

covers.title: Liability and physical damage
covers.text: Liability insurance, comprehensive, collision, uninsured motorist and medical payments.

covers.title: Non-ownership insurance
covers.text: Liability protection when an employee occasionally has to drive his or her personally owned vehicle for business purposes.

covers.title: Hired auto coverage
covers.text: Liability protection when a customer leases, hires, rents or borrows autos on a temporary basis.

services.title: General Liability
services.text: Trade contractors know their craft and need insurance that covers the things that matter.
services.lead: Whether a contractor, plumber or flooring specialist, Helix Insurance Group has coverages to protect trade contractors so they can focus on the job at hand.
services.imageAlt: A tradesman at work on a site

covers.title: Additional insureds
covers.text: Coverage for up to eight types of additional insureds, eliminating the need for separate endorsements or additional premium, such as engineers, architects, surveyors and lessors of equipment.

covers.title: Limited care, custody and control
covers.text: Protection covering the property of others in the care, custody or control of the insureds.

covers.title: Limited pollution liability
covers.text: Pollution coverage for job site accidents, including site assessment, clean-up and legal fees up to $100,000 per occurrence and $100,000 aggregate with a $250 deductible.

covers.title: Extension of property damage
covers.text: Coverage up to the policy limits for damage to the insured's completed work. This coverage must be requested.

covers.title: Installation coverage
covers.text: Coverage for materials to be installed by the contractor in a building undergoing renovation. $2,500 is automatically included and can be increased up to $100,000.

covers.title: Tools and equipment
covers.text: $2,500 for equipment that is owned or borrowed and $5,000 for rented or leased equipment, available up to $100,000 for owned or borrowed and $300,000 for rented or leased.

services.title: Workers Comp
services.text: It is not for you, it is for them. Workers' compensation coverage protects employees for work-related injuries.
services.lead: Workers' compensation coverage protects employees for work-related injuries and includes access to a wide network of claims professionals and fraud investigators.
services.imageAlt: A crew working on a job site

covers.title: Statutory benefits
covers.text: Though benefits vary by state, statutory coverage provides compensation for disability or death, medical benefits, temporary partial or total disability and permanent partial or total disability.

covers.title: Claims network
covers.text: Access to a wide network of claims professionals and fraud investigators.

covers.title: Medical management
covers.text: Registered nurses who coordinate care and medical bill review specialists who make sure payment for services is at the lowest available rates, so injured employees receive quality care while the medical costs that affect premium come down.

covers.title: Return-to-work programs
covers.text: Programs to get employees back to the job as soon as it is medically appropriate.

covers.title: MySafetyPoint
covers.text: An online comprehensive risk management tool that provides strategies to help manage common risks for a wide range of business classes, to help minimize the potential for a workplace injury or illness.

questions.q: What does workers' compensation pay for?
questions.a: Compensation for disability or death, medical benefits, and temporary or permanent partial or total disability, though benefits vary by state.

about.title: We are experts, and a 360 degree service for all your protection needs.
text: Helix Insurance Group is a 360 degree service for all your protection needs. We understand the complexities that exist in the insurance world when choosing proper coverage for your residential, commercial, and life planning needs.

Our approach is simple; we connect all of our customers with a professional insurance advisor whose primary aim is to exceed their expectations by offering the best coverages at the most competitive prices available. At our best, we are dedicated consultants assisting you in the decision making process. We take our job serious! We pledge to do our best to earn your business and promise to maintain a high sense of professionalism while doing so.

We all have experiences throughout our life that are worth sharing, such as childhood adventures, driving your first car, graduating from college, or purchasing your first home. Our purpose is to become great story tellers by educating and connecting with real people, because we believe that every person has a story to tell and it is our mission to protect it.

faqs.q: Who will I be working with?
faqs.a: We connect all of our customers with a professional insurance advisor whose primary aim is to exceed their expectations by offering the best coverages at the most competitive prices available.

faqs.q: How often should I review my policy?
faqs.a: It is a good practice to review your life insurance policy once every year. When changes in your life happen, you want to make sure you and your loved ones are well prepared.

faqs.q: How do you find the right policy?
faqs.a: Helix Insurance Group has the ability to shop among the most financially stable and reliable insurance companies to find the right insurance policy that meets your needs, coverage, and budget today.

faqs.q: Do your agents cover both personal and commercial lines?
faqs.a: Yes. We write personal lines including auto, home, life and recreational, and commercial lines including business owners policies, commercial auto, general liability and workers' compensation.
